extName.message: MemeBox: Meme Soundboard & Voice Changer for Calls

extDesc.message: Meme soundboard & voice changer for calls: play meme sounds and sound effects into your mic on Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Discord.

actionTitle.message: MemeBox: send this tab's sound to your call

join_first.message: Join the call first, then press 😂

err_reload.message: MemeBox was updated. Reload the call tab.

muted_nobody.message: You are muted, so memes are silent too. Unmute and try again.

no_lines.message: No lines yet. Add some in Options.

slot_empty.message: Nothing on Alt+$1 yet. Pick a favourite slot in Options.

ui_hidden.message: MemeBox is hidden. Press Alt+M to show it again.

tab_on.message: 📺 Your other tab's sound is going into the call

tab_bar.message: 📺 Another tab's sound is playing into your mic

st_none.message: You haven't joined a call yet. Join the call, then press 😂

st_suspended.message: Click anywhere on the page once to switch memes on

st_muted.message: You are muted, so memes stay silent until you unmute

fab_tip.message: Click: random meme · hold or right-click: panel · drag to move

btn_mic_test_tip.message: Plays a short ding-dong into your mic. Ask someone in the call if they heard it.

monitor_tip.message: The call always gets the meme through your mic. This only adds a quiet copy on your own speakers.

monitor_on.message: 🎧 You and the call both hear memes

monitor_off.message: 🔇 Only the call hears memes now

monitor_on_tip.message: You hear memes too (click to stop hearing them, the call still hears them)

monitor_off_tip.message: You don't hear memes (click to hear them too, the call hears them either way)

duck_tip.message: Memes get quieter while you are talking

panel_foot.message: Click a line to play it · 😂 random · Alt+1…9 favourites · Alt+0 stop · Alt+M hide

timers_on.message: ⏰ Timed lines are on (while a call is open): $1

empty_star.message: No favourites yet. Tap ☆ on a line.

pp_send.message: 🎙 Send this tab's sound to my call

pp_how1.message: Join your call in another tab (Meet, Zoom web, Teams web or Discord web).

pp_how2.message: In this tab, start the YouTube video or Instagram reel at the funny moment.

pp_how3.message: Click “Send this tab's sound” and everyone in the call hears it through your mic.

pp_how4.message: Click ⏹ when you're done, or use ⏹ in the 😂 panel.

pp_how_note.message: Nothing is downloaded or recorded. The sound is only mixed live into your mic.

pp_no_call.message: Join a call first (in another tab), then come back to the video tab and click here.

pp_this_is_call.message: This is your call tab. Open the YouTube / Instagram tab and click MemeBox there to send its sound. Use 😂 on this page for memes.

pp_sending.message: ✅ This tab's sound is going into your call.

pp_replace.message: Another tab is being sent right now. Sending this one will replace it.

pp_start_video.message: Start the video at the funny part, then:

pp_join_unmute.message: Join the call and unmute first.

pp_cant_capture.message: Chrome won't let this tab be captured: $1

op_sub.message: Your lines, clips, packs and party mode. Everything stays in this browser.

op_say.message: Pronounce as (optional, e.g. Devanagari for Hinglish lines)

op_shortcut_hint.message: Alt+1…3 and Alt+0 work everywhere. Change keys or add Alt+4…9 at

op_no_lines.message: No lines yet. Add one above, or add a pack below.

op_err_clip_missing.message: Clip not found. Add it again.

op_clips_hint.message: Use an audio file or a video (only its sound is kept), a direct file link, or record yourself. Then trim it. A saved clip can be up to 1 MB.

op_video_sites.message: YouTube, Instagram and other video pages are never downloaded. Play them live with the toolbar button → “Send this tab's sound”.

op_too_long.message: Too long for 1 MB. Keep it under about $1 s.

op_err_type.message: Use an audio or video file (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, MP4, WEBM)

op_err_no_audio.message: Couldn't find any sound in that file

op_err_too_big_source.message: That file is too big (max 50 MB before trimming)

op_err_url.message: Paste a full link starting with https://

op_err_video_page.message: That's a video page, not a file. MemeBox never downloads from YouTube, Instagram or other video sites. Open it in a tab and use the toolbar button → “Send this tab's sound”.

op_err_not_file.message: The link must end in .mp3, .mp4, .wav, .ogg or .webm

op_err_blocked.message: $1 doesn't let other sites use its files (it blocks CORS). Download the file and use “Choose a file” instead.

op_err_mic.message: MemeBox needs your OK to use the microphone for recording

op_packs_hint.message: A pack holds lines and their clips. Importing adds to your lines, and lines with the same id are replaced. Files are checked strictly.

op_export_partial.message: Exported $1 lines (clips from older versions were skipped)

op_import_invalid.message: That pack file isn't valid. See the list below.

op_party_hint.message: Off by default. Timers only fire while a call tab is open and your mic is connected.

op_timer_added_off.message: Timer added. Switch on “Play timed lines automatically” to use it.

op_privacy_text.message: Your microphone and tab audio are only mixed inside this browser. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent anywhere. No accounts, servers or analytics.

tab_volume.message: Volume of the tab sound in the call

voice_tip.message: Changes YOUR live voice in the call. Alt+V switches it on and off. "Off" gives your plain voice back instantly.

voice_now_off.message: Voice changer off, your normal voice is back

voice_after_join.message: Saved. It starts when you join the call.

cam_tip.message: Draws the meme text on the video others see from you. Turn your camera off and on to apply. Your own preview may show it mirrored, but others see it the right way.

cam_on.message: Camera captions on. Turn your camera off and on to apply.

cam_off.message: Camera captions off. Turn your camera off and on to apply.

op_save_wav_tip.message: Save as an audio file (WAV) to share anywhere

op_share_wa_tip.message: Opens WhatsApp with the text filled in. You choose the chat and press send.

pro_only.message: This is a MemeBox Pro feature.

ob_sub.message: Three steps and you're the funniest person in the call.

ob_s1.message: Join your call in the browser

ob_s1_text.message: Google Meet, Zoom (web), Microsoft Teams (web) or Discord (web). The 😂 button appears in the corner. If the call was already open, reload it once.

ob_s2_text.message: It goes into your microphone, so everyone in the call hears it. They don't need MemeBox. When you're muted, memes are silent too.

ob_s3_text.message: Pick any line, search, change your voice (Alt+V), or play favourites with Alt+1 to Alt+9. To play a YouTube video into the call, click the MemeBox icon in the toolbar on that tab.

ob_mic_hint.message: Check that your microphone works. The sound stays on this page. Nothing is recorded.

ob_mic_ok.message: ✅ We hear you. Your mic works.

ob_mic_blocked.message: The microphone is blocked. Click the camera/mic icon in the address bar and allow it.

ob_mic_none.message: No microphone found. Plug one in and try again.

ob_done.message: You're ready. Your lines, clips and packs are in Settings.

ob_reload_title.message: A call tab is already open

ob_reload_text.message: It was opened before MemeBox, so it can't use memes yet. Reload it, then join the call again. Reloading leaves the call, so do it when you're ready.

pp_reload_tab.message: This call tab was open before MemeBox was installed or updated. Reload it (F5), then join the call again.

op_picture_hint.message: Your picture stays visible until you close it with ×, Escape or Stop all. Others see it when Caption on my camera is on. Use pictures you own or have permission to share.

op_err_picture.message: That file isn't a picture MemeBox can use. Try PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF.

op_err_picture_big.message: That picture is too big. Try a smaller one (up to 20 MB).

pro_pictures.message: You have used your $1 picture meme(s). Get more with MemeBox Pro or a picture pack (Options → MemeBox Pro).

op_bulk_hint.message: Import many files: each one becomes a clip (cut to fit 1 MB) named after its file, in the "clips" category.

op_pro_off.message: Pro is switched off in this build, so every feature is unlocked for everyone and no key is needed.

op_pro_active.message: ✅ MemeBox Pro is active in this browser.

op_pro_free.message: Free plan: up to $1 picture meme(s), 10 clips, the General and College packs.

op_license_offline.message: Couldn't reach the MemeBox site. Check your internet and try again.

op_license_stale.message: The key $1 couldn't be checked for a long time. Go online so MemeBox can check it again.

op_license_pro.message: Key $1: unlimited Pro Max. Every light, character, filter and tune is unlocked.

ob_theme_hint.message: Pick a look for MemeBox. You can change it any time in Settings.

text_dir.description: Writing direction of this language: ltr or rtl. Not shown.

lang_code.description: Language code for the HTML lang attribute. Not shown.

lang_reload.message: Language changed. Reload this call tab to see MemeBox in it.

fx_how.message: A lamp and coloured lights on YOUR camera. Others in the call see them. Try everything on the preview below.

fx_hint_off.message: Switch on to try it. Join or rejoin the call to use it.

fx_restart.message: Turn your camera off and on once in the call to start the lights.

fx_locked.message: 🔒 Preview only: not sent to your call.

fx_focus_tip.message: Darker edges so the light is on your face

fx_sync_tip.message: Colours change with the meme you play

fx_safe_tip.message: Safer for people sensitive to flashing

fx_pass_none.message: No pass yet. Preview is free; a pass lets others see it in your call.

mu_how.message: Our original tunes play into your call and get quieter while you talk.

mu_locked.message: 🔒 Preview only (on your speakers, not in the call).

mu_preview.message: Preview: $1, $2 seconds, only you hear it

mu_idle.message: Tap a tune to hear it. Free: Chill and Funky.

mu_idle_call.message: Tap a tune to play it into your call.

fx_follow_tip.message: Tracks your face locally so the companion follows you and notices when you leave or return.

fx_away.message: Party when I leave the picture

fx_away_tip.message: The animal looks for you, then dances and the lights party. They welcome you back.

fx_studio_tip.message: If your room is dark, MemeBox lifts your picture so you are clearly seen, even with no lamp.

as_btn.message: Add a sound from a file (audio or video)

as_bad.message: $1 is not a sound or video file, or it is too big

mu_join.message: Join a call first, then play your music

mu_many.message: 12 tracks is the most. Remove one first.

fx_drag.message: Drag in the preview to hang the lamp exactly where you want it.

fx_hd_tip.message: Cleans grain, smooths skin but keeps eyes and hair sharp, adds clarity and natural colour, and lifts a dark room. Runs on your graphics card.

st_1.message: 1. Join your call in the browser and unmute your mic.

st_2.message: 2. Tap any meme: everyone in the call hears it.

st_3.message: 3. Want lights, a lamp or an animal on your camera? Open Lights below.

fx_angle.message: Light angle (from the lamp onto you)

fx_mirror.message: Left / Right as I see myself

fx_mirror_tip.message: Like a mirror: your Left is the left of your own video. Untick if it looks the wrong way round.

fx_gest.message: React to my face and hands

fx_gest_tip.message: Copies supported waves, smiles and gestures. Keep your face and hands in view; adjust sensitivity if reactions are missed.

fx_try.message: Try: 👍 ✌️ 👌 🤘 🤙 ✋ 👏 ❤️ (two hands or fingers), nod, shake your head, 😛, kiss.

fx_seen_none.message: The camera sees nobody yet (camera on? Follow me ticked?)

cam_unmirror.message: Flip my preview back while a caption shows

cam_unmirror_tip.message: While a caption shows on your camera, your own tile (which the call site mirrors) is flipped back for 3 seconds so you can read it. Others always see it the right way.

fx_masti_tip.message: On: climbs, flies or hops between resting places. Off: returns to your selected resting place, with gentle idle movements.

fx_sounds_tip.message: Plays short synthesized reactions, including cheers and sobs, into your microphone. Turn off for silent reactions.

fx_seen_off.message: The face model is not answering yet. Wait a few seconds; if it stays like this, reload the call tab.

op_online_hint.message: Free music and memes for everyone. Nothing is contacted until you press Browse; downloads come from the MemeBox site.

op_online_fail.message: Could not get the packs. Check your internet and try again.

op_online_none.message: No packs here yet. New ones are added regularly.

op_online_limit.message: Daily download limit reached ($1 added). The rest can be added tomorrow.

op_online_space.message: Packs on this computer: $1 of $2 MB

op_online_full.message: This computer's space for packs is full ($1 added, $2 MB in total). Remove a pack to add more.

mu_phonk_tip.message: Official phonk tracks played through YouTube, then sent into your call

pg_personality_help.message: Try the signature action, then leave and return. This uses the same companion engine as your camera.

pg_away_status.message: Waiting for you. Music will not turn the companion happy while you are away.

pg_home_status.message: You are here. Your companion can explore, listen and react.

fx_home_tip.message: When exploring is off, the companion stays here. A face must be detected for head and shoulder positions.

fx_commands.message: Tell your companion what to do

fx_commands_tip.message: These controls affect the character in your outgoing camera. Waiting and crying still take priority when you leave.

fx_away_explain.message: When you leave, your companion looks for you, waits and cries. It stays sad or floats in its tears until you return.

fx_outfit_help.message: Basic accessories are free. Pro designs can be owned forever when their shop opens. Interactive Pro Max designs are exclusive to the pass.

pg_music_help.message: All 16 bundled tunes are here, including 3 original Phonk tracks. Preview on your speakers; music in the call is under the Music tab.

pg_music_add_help.message: In a browser call: open the MemeBox panel, select Music, then Add my music. Select an audio file you own or may share. Original Phonk is already bundled; YouTube playlists need the site and verified links.

pg_pictures_help.message: Add a picture to a meme in Options. Play it from the Pictures tab during a call. It stays until you close it with ×, Escape or Stop all. Enable camera captions to send it to other callers.

pg_picture_privacy.message: This preview stays on this device. No upload or storage service is used.

pg_collection_help.message: For everyone is the default. India and other regions are optional collections, available to everyone; your interface language stays your choice.

pictures_help.message: Your picture memes, in one place. Pictures stay until ×, Escape or Stop all. Camera captions must be on for other callers to see them.

pictures_empty.message: No picture memes yet. Add a picture to a meme in Options, then come back here.

mu_phonk_local_tip.message: Listen to our three original Phonk tracks in the Playground. Free YouTube playlists require the site and verified official links.

mu_collection_help.message: Original tunes run on your device. Add your own audio below; no hosted music subscription is required.

pg_persona_cat.message: Quiet paws, grooming and stretching. Climbs to your shoulder.

pg_persona_dog.message: A playful trot, panting and wagging. Waits for you to return.

pg_persona_bunny.message: Springy hops, ear wiggles and nibbling.

pg_persona_panda.message: Slow steps, bamboo munching and relaxed rolls.

pg_persona_owl.message: Flies between perches, turns its head and hoots.

pg_persona_fox.message: Soft prowling, a swishing tail and pouncing.

pg_persona_lion.message: A measured prowl, mane shakes and yawns.

pg_persona_monkey.message: Climbs with alternating hands, scratches and swings.

pg_persona_frog.message: Hops, croaks and catches a little fly.

pg_persona_unicorn.message: Prances with a rainbow tail and sparkles.

pg_persona_robot.message: Marches in measured steps, scans and beeps.

pg_persona_snake.message: Slithers, coils and flicks its forked tongue.

pg_persona_bird.message: Flies with flapping wings, preens and pecks.

pg_picture_too_big.message: Choose an image smaller than 8 MB.

pg_picture_invalid.message: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.

adult_help.message: Off by default. This is a self-declared preference, not verified age. Turning it off hides marked content and stops current MemeBox playback. Unmarked content cannot be classified automatically.

adult_blocked.message: Adult memes are hidden. Enable the 18+ preference first.

content_help.message: Recommended uses your chosen meme language. Explore all opens every language and region. Regions are collections, not restrictions.

content_private.message: Your personal additions stay private on this device and appear with your memes across language views. Categories keep related memes together. Only admin-published packs become available to other users.

plans_link.message: Plans, prices and how to buy

plans_closed.message: Payments are not open in this local review. You can preview all features here. No purchase will be made.

plans_draft.message: Draft price, not on sale yet

plans_max_only.message: Included only with Pro Max; never individually sold

plans_filters.message: Filters: Free, Pro and Pro Max

plans_checkout_help.message: Checkout opens on the MemeBox site when the shop is enabled. International payment methods depend on provider approval.

plans_ownership_help.message: A costume does not unlock its animal. Owned Pro filters and costumes work without a pass; automatic tracking and gestures need a running pass.

plans_pro_count.message: 18 filters and 10 standard characters; 7 regular tunes plus Desi Phonk

plans_max_count.message: 28 filters, all 14 characters and all 16 bundled tunes; exclusive reactive costumes

pk_manage_help.message: Published packs are added by the owner in the admin console. You choose which packs to keep locally; your own imports never publish automatically.

room_heading.message: Pick a playlist. Feel the drop.

room_intro.message: Free YouTube collections and original MemeBox music in one place. Browse every collection, wherever you are; YouTube availability may vary.

room_youtube_help.message: YouTube uses its visible player and may show ads or restrict a video. Original music runs on your device.

room_local_help.message: For the local YouTube player, run Start-MemeBox-Music.cmd from the extracted review folder once. No Node installation is needed. It opens a localhost page with a valid website referrer.

room_supplied.message: Starter collections for every listener. Rename or replace them whenever you want; YouTube controls the songs and availability.

room_empty.message: No matching playlists. Change the search or add a collection.

room_private.message: Changes are saved only on this browser. They do not publish for other users.

room_original_help.message: Phonk builds into a pause and beat drop, then returns with a layered second drop. Other tunes cover chill, funk, party and more.

room_call_help.message: Original tunes play into your mic from the call panel’s Music tab. For YouTube, keep the website player open, click the MemeBox toolbar icon and choose Send this tab’s sound. Ads are included in captured tab audio.

room_review.message: Local review: paid music is unlocked, checkout is closed, and nothing is deployed.

room_storage_error.message: Could not save in this browser. Your changes remain available until the page closes.

room_web_required.message: YouTube playback opens in the website player so it receives a valid web referrer.

room_youtube_loading.message: YouTube player opened. Press Play in the visible player if autoplay is blocked.

room_original_playing.message: Playing on your speakers. To send originals into a call, use the call panel’s Music tab.

room_preview.message: 20-second preview on your speakers. This tune requires its applicable pass in a call.

room_preview_finished.message: Preview finished. View Plans for this tune’s tier.

room_collection_meta.message: Free · YouTube controls the song list

room_invalid.message: Enter a name and a valid HTTPS YouTube playlist link or playlist ID.

room_duplicate.message: This playlist is already saved. Edit its existing card instead.

room_limit.message: Keep up to $1 playlists. Remove one before adding another.

room_embed_error.message: YouTube could not play this selection (error $1). Its availability, age or embedding restrictions may prevent playback.

room_adult.message: I’m 18+; show collections marked with strong language

room_published_help.message: The owner can update these collections without an extension release. Browse to load the current catalog.

room_catalog_paused.message: Published Phonk collections are paused by the owner.

room_catalog_empty.message: No published collections yet. Your own playlists above remain available.

room_catalog_unavailable.message: The published catalog is unavailable here. Your own playlists above remain available.

wn_title.description: Heading of the one-time card shown after the extension updates itself.

wn_1.message: Memes in 26 languages, spoken in that language's voice.

wn_2.message: Free packs: more sounds and memes to add.

wn_3.message: Lights, and a cat or dog, on your camera.

wn_ok.description: Button that closes the what-is-new card.
